headline: 30th CELEBRATION card list revealed
bullets: Full card list now public on the official 30th site
Classic-art reprints are the headline pull
Japanese print run only — no English version announced
caption:
Japan just revealed the full card list for the 30th CELEBRATION expansion pack (M6a). 🎉

The set leans hard into nostalgia: classic artwork reprints sitting next to modern ex cards, which is exactly the combination that made earlier anniversary sets so hard to find a year later.

As always, this is a Japanese-language release — no English printing has been announced, so the only way to get these is straight from Japan.

Source: the official Pokémon Card Game site (pokemon-card.com).

headline: Espeon & Umbreon premium deck set
bullets: Two ready-to-play decks in one box
Espeon ex and Umbreon ex are the centrepieces
Selling well above retail in Japan already
caption:
The 30th CELEBRATION Premium Deck Set featuring Espeon & Umbreon has had its contents revealed in Japan. 🌙☀️

It's two complete decks in one box, built around Espeon ex and Umbreon ex. Eeveelution products have a long history of selling out on day one here, and this one is already trading above retail on the Japanese secondary market.

Japanese release only.

Source: the official Pokémon Card Game site (pokemon-card.com).

headline: 30th anniversary deck shields
bullets: Several designs launched on the same day
Sleeve sets like these usually vanish fast
caption:
A full wave of 30th anniversary deck shields (card sleeves) went on sale in Japan on September 16. 🃏

Anniversary sleeve designs are one of those things collectors outside Japan rarely see in person — they're produced in limited runs for the domestic market and disappear from shelves within weeks.

Source: the official Pokémon Card Game site (pokemon-card.com).

headline: Champions League 2027 Yokohama
bullets: One of Japan's biggest Pokémon TCG tournaments
Worlds 2027 qualification points on the line
Live stream announced for the event
caption:
Champions League 2027 Yokohama — one of the largest Pokémon TCG tournaments in Japan — was held this month, with a live stream and Worlds 2027 qualification on the line. 🏆

Japanese Champions League events are worth watching even if you don't play competitively: the decks that win here tend to decide which cards spike on the Japanese secondary market a week later.

Source: the official Pokémon Card Game site (pokemon-card.com).

headline: 25th Anniversary promo pack notice
bullets: Covers tournament use of the 25th promo cards
Worth checking if you collect the 2021 promos
Full details on the official site
caption:
The Pokémon Company issued a notice in Japan about the use of cards from the 25th ANNIVERSARY promo card pack. 📢

If you collect the 2021 anniversary promos — the Gold Star reprints, the shining cards, Birthday Pikachu — it's worth reading the official notice rather than relying on secondhand summaries.

Source: the official Pokémon Card Game site (pokemon-card.com).
